query: I can't help but think that my parents prefer my sister to me. Sometimes I caught myself wishing I was more like her.
I enrolled in the university studying finance because my parents thought it would be a good career choice. But I'm not sure if it's what I really want. Actually, I don't really know what I want.
I so much want the cool kid at school to like me that I just suck up to her all the time. It's pathetic.
I've been looking for a job for half a year and all I ever get are rejections.

I saw my neighbours with their children and grandchildren the other day. They were so blissful together. I regret that I enstranged myself from my family and I wish I could go back in time to fix things.
I regret my choice on being a parent. I really don't think I'm suited for it. I do like my children, but I'm not sure I love them as a parent should.
I feel very insecure in my relationship. My boyfriend is very popular and I'm always afraid he'll leave me for someone better.
I've been a regulatory affair manager for 10 years and frankly, I hate this job and I don't give a damn at all. But I don't have other skills to land a different job and I feel so trapped.
My PhD thesis is going no where and sometimes I think I just don't have what it takes and that I'm just not good enough.
I'm promoted to a higher position, but I suspect it's only because I'm a woman. I'm afraid I'm just there for the diversity and people know it.
